speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I see you are presenting with increasing yellow discoloration of your eyes and skin; have you noticed if this color is spreading to your abdomen or if your baby is feeding well?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Hyperbilirubinemia (Breastfeeding Jaundice).

To determine if this is physiological or pathological, have you noticed any dark urine or clay-colored stools, and was your baby's first stool passed within 24 hours of birth?
